name: prodqc-agent
description: Effect-TS domain, multi-agent, transparency, insurance, and self-improvement abstractions for multi-modality bio-production & QC (protein, LNP, and future modalities)

scripts.deps:ext4: PROJECT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/projects/$(basename "$PWD")-$(pwd -P | sha1sum | cut -c1-8)" && mkdir -p "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR" && cp package.json "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/package.json" && npm --prefix "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR" install --cache "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/npm" --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: PROJECT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/projects/$(basename "$PWD")-$(pwd -P | sha1sum | cut -c1-8)" && node --preserve-symlinks "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc" --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions true --outDir "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/dist" && node --test "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/dist/tests/abstractions.test.js"
